previous_human_verdict.verbatim: 图片可以。设计感很一般。

candidate.concept: 让真实陶盘上沿成为照片窗口的边界，并把这条盘沿曲线延伸到留白中，照片本身参与画面骨架，而不是一张矩形照片贴在独立文字栏旁边。
candidate.image_editing: No food pixels retouched; the original PNG is uniformly scaled and clipped by a vector viewport only. Original file remains separate and unchanged.
candidate.main_visual_mechanism: The actual visible ceramic plate rim is used as the curved top edge of the image viewport; a continuous vector contour extends from the source rim into the negative space.
candidate.typography: Editable ordinary Noto Sans CJK SC text only; no custom wordmark/Chinese lettering design attempted.
candidate.design_claim: A distinct layout mechanism has been attempted, but no claim of high design quality until user review.

critique.improvement_over_B1: The food photo no longer sits inside a plain right-aligned rectangle; its actual plate geometry shapes the page boundary and the contour continues into the surrounding negative space.
residual_risks: The arc may still read as a decorative stroke rather than a necessary design mechanism.
The title block is still conventional and intentionally not custom-designed.
The single curved image edge may not create enough brand distinctiveness by itself.

next: Present B2 as a new non-generative layout candidate; record human verdict separately. If design still feels average, stop micro-adjustments and change the art-direction concept rather than tuning colors/coordinates.
